question: ‘The God of Small Things’, a winner of the 1997 Booker Prize, is the debut novel of which of the following Indian writers?
solution:
The correct answer is __Arundhati Roy__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The God of Small Things is a novel written by Indian writer Arundhati Roy .

 
 
• Arundhati Roy was awarded **Man Booker Prize for fiction in 1997** for her novel The God of Small Things.

 
 
• Her notable works include:
 
 
• The God of Small Things
 
• The Ministry of Utmost Happiness
 
• Kashmir: the case of freedom
 
• Azadi:&a
